item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","instrument_review":"Using the supplied MESA questions, ARC-AGI-2 supports comparisons of performance on unfamiliar grid puzzles under specified conditions. Exact-grid scoring and public marking tests support inspection. Repeated-run stability, score uncertainty and broader intelligence interpretations remain insufficiently supported.","supported_claims":[{"claim":"Scores describe performance on grid-rule problems.","reason":"Systems infer transformations from examples and submit output grids."},{"claim":"Scoring permits partial credit across inputs within a problem.","reason":"The software averages input successes within each problem, then averages problem scores."},{"claim":"Human solving informed test selection.","reason":"Developers used a human study to select sets with similar human difficulty."},{"claim":"Some marking behavior was tested.","reason":"Public tests cover correct grids, incorrect sizes, changed squares and missing outputs."}],"documented_problems":[{"claim":"Published uses of 'solved' differ.","reason":"The software awards fractional problem scores, while the dataset description reserves fully solved for success on every input."},{"claim":"Materials required corrections.","reason":"The change record lists corrected squares and unclear examples."},{"claim":"Public evaluation problems permit prior exposure.","reason":"Anyone can inspect them, and hidden-data safeguards also acknowledge possible leakage."},{"claim":"Testing routes can use different conditions.","reason":"ARC Prize's verified rules do not govern every community evaluation."}],"missing_information":[{"claim":"Variation across identical repeated runs.","reason":"Verified testing uses one run, and no repeated-run score ranges are supplied."},{"claim":"Sensitivity to instructions and presentation.","reason":"No systematic study of these changes is supplied."},{"claim":"Evidence supporting broader performance predictions.","reason":"No supplied study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"claim":"Complete effects of revisions on comparisons.","reason":"The change record does not recalculate every affected AI score."}],"reinterpretations":[{"term":"AI","meaning":"For verified results, the tested system includes its configured settings and spending conditions; other testing routes may define different evaluated configurations.","reason":"The passage distinguishes verified conditions from other routes."},{"term":"Reasoning or intelligence","meaning":"The directly observed performance is solving two-dimensional grid problems.","reason":"Broader intelligence relationships are not established by the supplied studies."}],"closing_note":"No separate review method was assigned; this review applies MESA directly. 'Solved' needs clarification when distinguishing input success, fractional problem scores and fully solved problems.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The version, public test set and official scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rule inference, AI comparisons and broader reasoning interpretations are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs, new inputs and required output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Attempts, settings and spending rules are described, but conditions differ across testing routes."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact matching and averaging within and across problems are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring transformations from examples is linked to learning unfamiliar rules."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Origins, human difficulty selection and duplicate-rule removal are explained; broader representativeness is not established."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and corrections show checking, but comprehensive checks of problems and reference outputs are not established."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid tasks support rule inference, but coverage of broader reasoning and intelligence is not established."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact output matching reflects successful transformations, but nearly correct grids receive no credit."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Aggregation is explicit, but support for its interpretation as an ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests exercise correct and erroneous outputs; complete validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human solving informed difficulty and AI scores are reported, but the human study covered a larger pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No repeated-run study is supplied; verified testing uses one run."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic sensitivity study is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Score variation estimates or ranges are not supplied."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Program-search resistance and repeated-rule checks address some unintended routes."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data safeguards address exposure, but public tasks are accessible and leakage remains possible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific tuning discouraged and repeated feedback-based improvement excluded from verified testing."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied study establishes prediction beyond grid problems."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings are recorded and human background factors examined, but conditions differ across routes."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection of the scoped public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, handling and review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated corrections and code changes are recorded, but their effects on every affected score are not reconstructed."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-performance claims are supported; broader intelligence connections lack supplied validation."}]},{"benchmark":"designqa","instrument_review":"Using the supplied MESA questions, DesignQA supports examining performance on specified engineering-document tasks under reported conditions. Real engineering materials support relevance, while scoring artifacts, unequal information supplies and incomplete reproducibility limit comparisons. Transfer to other engineering documents remains unresolved.","supported_claims":[{"claim":"The benchmark examines several engineering-document tasks.","reason":"Its six groups cover rule retrieval, terminology, components, dimensions and performance requirements."},{"claim":"The tasks have practical engineering relevance.","reason":"They use competition rules, vehicle designs and test data with practitioner contributions."},{"claim":"Some setup changes and marking behavior were tested.","reason":"The authors varied passages and visual information, and released small marking-test files."},{"claim":"Transfer to other documents remains uncertain.","reason":"The paper explicitly acknowledges this limitation."}],"documented_problems":[{"claim":"Wording and formatting can affect credit.","reason":"Examples include missing commas and valid related rules absent from references."},{"claim":"Question groups are highly uneven.","reason":"Individual-rule retrieval has 1,192 questions, while performance checking has 16."},{"claim":"Systems receive different information.","reason":"Some receive the entire rulebook and others receive retrieved passages."},{"claim":"An always-yes strategy could earn decision credit on one portion.","reason":"All described scale-bar drawings comply; this does not establish that any AI used that strategy."},{"claim":"Released materials have a completeness discrepancy.","reason":"One answer file contains fewer rows than the paper's corresponding question count."}],"missing_information":[{"claim":"Complete marking validation and residual error rates.","reason":"Small tests and reviewer checks do not establish comprehensive accuracy or consistency."},{"claim":"Variation under identical repeated conditions.","reason":"The five passage sets change the information supplied."},{"claim":"Adequate uncertainty for close model comparisons.","reason":"The supplied reporting is insufficient to assess small differences confidently."},{"claim":"Prior-exposure checks and evaluation-use policies.","reason":"A protected set, systematic overlap check and clear training or repeated-submission rules are not established."},{"claim":"Complete reproducibility and reuse documentation.","reason":"Historical inputs and settings are not fully linked to results, and licensing and responsible-reuse rules were not found."},{"claim":"Evidence of transfer beyond these tasks.","reason":"No supplied study establishes prediction for other standards or engineering projects."}],"reinterpretations":[{"term":"AI","meaning":"Comparative results describe the AI together with its supplied rulebook or retrieval process.","reason":"Different systems receive different information."},{"term":"Engineering understanding","meaning":"Scores directly describe performance on the six task groups using the selected Formula SAE materials.","reason":"One rulebook and limited task coverage do not establish broader engineering competence."}],"closing_note":"No separate review method was assigned; this review applies MESA directly. Comparisons need clarification about whether 'AI system' includes retrieval and how differently marked group scores should be interpreted.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, question collection and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Abilities, tested AI systems and intended comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task types, supplied materials and answer formats are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but historical settings and inputs are not fully linked to each result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Group marking methods and equal-weight overall aggregation are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The tasks are linked to parts of engineers' document-based work."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real materials justify relevance, but one rulebook and uneven task coverage limit the selection's scope."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and narrower explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six task types cover relevant activities, but their range and distribution are limited."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions earn credit, but wording, formatting and incomplete references also affect scores."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but evidence supporting the combined or separate skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and scoring checks show testing occurred; comprehensive validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide comparisons, but no human-engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Changing passage sets does not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images were varied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation provides some information, but uncertainty for the main comparisons is insufficient."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and familiarity were examined, but unintended routes were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and protected evaluation data are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear training and repeated-submission rules are not supplied."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Transfer to other documents and engineering projects is not established."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information supplies are described, but differences complicate fair model comparisons."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but do not fully reconstruct every reported evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found in the inspected material."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code revisions are identifiable, but their effects on scores lack a clear explanatory record."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges important limits, while broader competence claims and close rankings require more support."}]}]}
